title: ValueHelpDialog
description: Fiori value help dialog (composite after the Fiori design guidelines): Search and Select with filters and a result table, Define Conditions, selected items and conditions as tokens, single/multi selection.

usage.summary: Find business values through a searchable result table or define filter conditions in a dialog.
useWhen: Let users find business values among more than 200 entries or identify them by several searchable attributes.
Let users select one or several matching records, or define ranges and filter conditions.
Keep a distinct search-and-confirm task when a suggestion label alone cannot identify the right value.
Supply columns, items and keyField; use selectionMode="multiple" with supportConditions for ranges, and onSearch for caller-filtered results.

avoidWhen.when: Pick one of 2–12 predefined values without other attributes (sort alphabetically above 8), or enter text without a selection/search task.
Choose one suggestion by type-ahead across 20–200 options or accept free text without a separate search task.
Choose simple records in a searchable list dialog, or select several predefined values inline without conditions.
Enter several caller-validated tokens, including values from datasets above 200, without a separate multiattribute search task.
Personalize which filter fields appear, their order and conditions across fields rather than select values for one field.
